newsitem.title: USA: Techs seen leading U.S. stocks higher at start.
newsitem.headline: Techs seen leading U.S. stocks higher at start.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to head higher at the start of trading Friday, led by the high technology sector, after Microsoft Corp reported better-than-forecast fiscal third quarter profits.
Shares of Microsoft extended their rally ahead of the opening bell, trading at 105, up 2-1/2 from the level hit in after-hours trade last night.
Analysts said there was little aside from the techs to influence the market as there was not economic data due out today. The long bond was down 1/32 to yield 7.07 percent.
